import ladon,json,sys,zipfile,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
base=Path(ladon.__file__).parent
assert 'site-packages' in str(base),base
with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as z:
 names=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('ladon/') and not n.endswith('/')]
 for n in names: assert z.read(n)==(base.parent/n).read_bytes(),n
print(json.dumps({'moduleOrigin':str(base),'verifiedWheelFiles':len(names),'pythonVersion':sys.version},indent=2))
